procedure.does: Recover every brief and every model-facing prompt from primary sources (transcripts, repo, commits, generation payloads). Mark anything reconstructed.
Write the pipeline the methodology believes in, then the pipeline that actually produced the outputs (which inputs reached the model).
Extract every instruction line; classify (INSTRUCTION_CATEGORIES); do not merge similar instructions.
Pair instructions that cannot both hold; name the output failure each causes and its severity.
Per variable: locked / guided / free. If free space is only the background, concepts will collapse into backdrop swaps.
For every quality adjective: visual meaning, minimum evidence, structural consequence, and how a model satisfies the word but not the founder.
Measure words by bucket (creative / product truth / process / render / QA / negative) and negative vs positive creative lines.
List every reference: role, whether it was actually attached, and what the model could extract from it. Compare against the strongest approved references.
Put each output beside the exact input that produced it (prompt + attached image). If the output reproduces the input, the input is the cause.
Assign a failure class per observed failure with evidence and HIGH / MEDIUM / LOW confidence. Blame the renderer only with proof.
Rewrite the prompt architecture (layers, priority tiers, freedom budget, evidence minimums, tests) — not the next prompt.

architecture.rule: First. Each reference has one role (WORLD · BRAND · COMPOSITION · TYPOGRAPHY · PRODUCT · QUALITY_BAR), is actually attached, and comes with an extraction sheet (REFERENCE_CONSUMPTION_TEST).
The inherited world, named as a place with mandatory visual evidence — not adjectives.
One thesis per concept in plain positive language; what makes it this concept and not its siblings.
Exact values and copy with provenance. Locks truth, not presentation.
How product and world relate in space (frame, planes, where the quiet field comes from), for this concept.
Declared LOCKED / GUIDED / FREE per variable.
Mandatory visual evidence with countable minimums.
Generate the whole; correct the parts. Deterministic only where exactness requires it.
Benchmark side-by-side, anti-generic, anti-assembly, reference-consumption, product clarity.

priority_tiers.holds: Exact product data and copy, nav items and order, official logo asset, no device chrome, project hard rules (e.g. uppercase, no circular controls).
The approved world / design-system references, attached and bound (image-to-image where the renderer supports it), and the approved finish level.
One compositional thesis per concept: what the page is, what the eye does, what the idea is.
What each concept may change (declared freedom budget).
Route, model, resolution, ownership of exact layers, correction method.
Evidence tests run after rendering. QA items are never pasted into the generator prompt.

exclude: percent geometry for more than the 3 main zones

layout.rule: Edge-led editorial or CENTER_STAGE per the founder decision below; nav zone and 2-second clarity fixed.

primary_object.rule: Each concept its own — inside the inherited world.

logo_placement.rule: Official asset; lockup top-left by default; one in-world brand cue allowed (book spine, seal, stationery).

amount_placement.rule: Largest numeral, in the upper 60 %, any alignment or scale.

cta_placement.rule: Label locked; square-rounded; position and material free above the nav.

category_visualization.rule: Names locked (BILLS · PLANS · GOALS · BUFFER); form free; never blank objects.

brand_framing.rule: Lockup + in-world cue; never a box.

environment.rule: The JURNL world (F01.00 WELCOME APPROVED family) — viewpoint, room and time of day may vary.

materials.rule: World palette incl. burgundy and sea-blue masses; rough / sheer / soft contrast required.

typography.rule: JURNL fonts and uppercase locked; scale, crop and relation to the world free.

secondary_modules.rule: Purchase bridge copy locked; form free (card, note, object, inline).

mandatory_evidence.minimum: ≥ 1 arch or arcade; ≥ 1 view out to sea / coast or sunlit exterior; limewash or rough travertine visible; directional sun with cast shadows.
≥ 3 planes: a foreground element (out-of-focus olive, drape), a mid-ground still life or object, a background (architecture / view).
≥ 4 materials incl. 1 rough mineral, 1 soft textile, 1 translucent; ≥ 1 accent colour mass (burgundy / rose / sea blue).
One display element ≥ 56 pt (word or figure); a tracked deck; one deliberate asymmetry; type participates in the image.
Olive or greenery in ≥ 2 places, one of them foreground.
The product zone’s quiet field is produced by architecture or light (lit wall, curtain glow, sky), not by a panel.
Official lockup exact; ≥ 1 in-world brand cue rendered faithfully.
Amount legible at 25 % thumbnail; SAFE TO SPEND within one glance of the amount; CTA contrast ≥ 4.5:1; nav exact.
Zero blank plates / tags / guide boxes / placeholder panels; zero device chrome.

anti_generic_test.question: Replace the logo with another finance brand. Is the page still plausible for that brand?
Could this environment belong to a hotel, wellness or generic luxury app?
anti_generic_test.fail_if: YES — the world lacks the project’s own signifiers

anti_generic_test.question: Strip the imagery: is the page anatomy a stock fintech / card template?
Could this be a sibling family’s screen (e.g. TODAY) with the label changed?
Is every brand claim satisfied only by palette and material nouns?

anti_assembly_test.question: Can a viewer point to background plate, text layer and UI layer as separate construction systems?
Do UI shadows / highlights follow the scene’s light direction and softness?
Do UI and scene share grain, sharpness and colour grade?
Does at least one product element sit on, in or behind a scene surface (occlusion, perspective, material) rather than floating above everything?
Are there box edges, borders or panels unrelated to scene geometry?
Is any blank plate, tag, card, guide box or empty mockup surface visible?
Is UI scale consistent with the scene’s scale and viewpoint?

reference_consumption_test.rule: Before generation the agent writes an extraction sheet per reference; the generator prompt cites the items it applies; QA checks the output against the sheet (≥ 80 % of WORLD and COMPOSITION items visibly present).
extract: composition (where product sits relative to world; planes; quiet field source)
environment inventory (architecture, view, foreground, still life)
material inventory (rough / smooth / soft / translucent / accent)
brand rules (lockup position, in-world brand cue)
density (objects per plane, empty vs designed space)
type scale (headline / figure / deck sizes and alignment)

device_chrome_rule.canvas: A mobile authority is a PRODUCT CANVAS (e.g. JURNL 393×852 pt), not a phone screenshot.
excluded: OS status bar (time, signal, Wi-Fi, battery)
included: product-owned chrome only when an approved authority defines it (e.g. a product back / ask button, the product nav)
device_chrome_rule.geometry: OS safe-area insets may reserve empty space in the canvas; they never render content that imitates the OS.
device_chrome_rule.term: "System chrome" is ambiguous and must not appear in briefs; say DEVICE CHROME (excluded) or PRODUCT CHROME (named items).

concept_delivery_contract.is: One founder-review-ready authority image of the full product canvas: world, composition, exact product truth and brand, finished at the approved finish level, passing the anti-generic and anti-assembly tests.
is_not: a variant that shares its page anatomy with a sibling concept

general: One compositional thesis that a viewer can state in a sentence.
Intentional foreground, midground and background (≥ 3 planes) or a declared flat thesis that is itself designed.
A purposeful hierarchy: one figure, one action, everything else subordinate.
Typography that participates in the image (scale, placement, relation to surfaces) rather than floating on it.
Negative space that comes from the scene (a lit wall, a sky, a drape), not from an empty box.
Material and light continuity across product and world.
World specificity: signifiers that belong to this brand, not a genre.
No visible scaffolding and no generic filler.
f09: Stated thesis in one sentence, visible without the copy.
≥ 3 planes, including a foreground that frames the product.
The product zone’s quiet field comes from the world (light, architecture), not a box.
Type is part of the image: scale, crop, alignment to architecture; at least one product element shares a surface, plane or occlusion with the world.
One light: shadows, grain and colour grade continuous across product and world.
JURNL-world specificity: arch / view / still life / burgundy / book — not a genre.
Zero scaffolding, zero device chrome, zero filler.

model_responsibilities.OPUS: Creative direction, world inheritance, concept theses, composition comps over the approved world, generator briefs, reference extraction sheets.
model_responsibilities.IMAGE_MODEL: Full-frame image bound to the approved world: environment, objects, UI surfaces and the few large exact strings.
model_responsibilities.COMPOSITOR: Exactness only: logo swap, small text, nav, numbers — by region repaint with the scene’s light, grain and perspective.
model_responsibilities.COMPOSER: Production implementation after authority lock; never authority rendering.
model_responsibilities.QA: An agent or person other than the author: benchmark side-by-side, anti-generic, anti-assembly, reference consumption; the founder verdict is final.
model_responsibilities.correction: The division in the methodology is right in principle; it failed because the image model was never given the world and the compositor was asked to create the integration instead of correcting a whole image.
